name: DHL Supply Chain - IDS Fulfillment HQ DC - Plainfield IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Open-campus DC in the AllPoints Midwest logistics park. Street View (2019-06) of the Allpoints Parkway entrance shows an unobstructed driveway, no barrier arm, no sliding gate, no perimeter fence. Truck yards on the east and west faces are unfenced.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in either.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Cross-dock building with dock doors on both long faces (east and west); ~70 doors estimated, band 50+ confident.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Rows of unhitched trailers parked on both the east and west truck lanes; 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two opposite long faces support separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal truck yards on both faces can stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plainfield IN is part of the Indianapolis metro logistics corridor (AllPoints Midwest park, dense industrial fabric) = Urban.

citations.claim: DHL Supply Chain acquired IDS Fulfillment (HQ Plainfield, IN) and will continue operating all IDS facilities.
IDS HQ DC at 9431 Allpoints Parkway, Plainfield, IN 46168 (780,000 sq ft) now operates as IDS Fulfillment Powered by DHL Supply Chain.

verification.rationale: DHL acquired IDS May 2025 and operates the HQ DC at 9431 Allpoints Parkway; branded IDS Fulfillment Powered by DHL Supply Chain.
